item.description:
What's New

  • We now show transcription progress after you've recorded instead of a loading screen
  • Moved copy and delete note actions insde of an overflow menu
  • You can now delete offline notes

What's New

  • Now once you record a note, if it can't reach our servers it will save the audio and the transcript offline and let you sync it later when you have access to the internet again.
  • Zapier Beta is available in the Integrations tab (Click Zapier in that tab to join the beta)
  • Added a pause recording button while recording your note
  • You can now CMD+F in the note editor to find and replace text
  • You can now download the audio file for your original voice memo from the share icon
  • We fixed an issue where loading all your notes at launch could cause lag on starting a new recording
  • We increased the default number of notes loaded to 100 (Wow you all are recording a lot of notes!)
  • If you're viewing the transcript you won't see a pointless Copy Markdown option anymore
  • If you edited the transcript it now returns you to the notes if you choose to update the notes

What's New

  • Reverted back to old transcription engine (Sorry for the bugs folks)

    • Recently Added

  • Fixed an issue where toggling between transcript and note while in the editor is active it would delete your entire transcript
  • Fixed a bug where if you have Cleft launch on macOS start it wouldn't load your notes.
  • Added voice memo play back to all platforms
  • We now lazy load the notes list so that you can easily search all your notes locally after the app launches
  • Custom instructions now have a character limit to prevent AI conflicts.
